data.narrative:
Swarm Aero is a Seed-stage defense and security company that has raised $8M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of 10 companies—2 public and 8 private—operating in the same sector, including peers such as UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic at similar or adjacent funding stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression approach uses the $8M total raised as a proxy base value and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, implying a $20M valuation. The peer-median method references four same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations ranging from $125M (NODA AI) to $4.0B (Stark Defence), yielding a median of $700M. The wide range reflects heterogeneity in maturity and traction within the Defense & Security cohort.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $17M (low) to $805M (high), with a median of $360M. The substantial divergence between stage-progression ($20M) and peer-median ($700M) reflects structural uncertainty around whether Swarm Aero's current traction and market positioning warrant valuation at the upper or lower end of the Defense & Security peer range. Key sensitivities include technology differentiation relative to the peer set, customer acquisition progress, and defensibility of intellectual property claims—none of which can be resolved through comparable valuation alone.
